notes: The APN aggregate maximum bit rate is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 4 octets and a maximum length of 8 octets
If octet 5 is included, then octet 6 shall also be included, and octets 7-8 may be included
If octet 7 is included, then octet 8 shall also be included
The length of the APN-AMBR IE can be either 4 octets, 6 octets or 8 octets
